picks.editorial_note: AI assisted a neurosurgeon in real time during live human brain tumor surgery for the first time, analyzing the surgical video feed to help protect critical tissue — a landmark clinical translation of AI from research into the operating room.
picks.title: First patient in live AI-assisted sight-saving brain surgery

picks.editorial_note: SK hynix's $4 billion advanced packaging facility at Purdue Research Park is a major manufacturing investment establishing the first U.S. hub for high-bandwidth memory production, a critical input for AI hardware supply chains.
picks.title: SK hynix breaks ground on $4 billion advanced packaging production facility in Purdue Research Park

picks.editorial_note: Georgetown scholars grapple with the implications of AI being used to design entirely novel viral genomes not found in nature, a development with serious biosecurity and research-governance stakes.
picks.title: AI Can Now Create Viruses. Should We Let It? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: UT Austin will lead a new NSF Science and Technology Center dedicated to how humans and robots adapt to one another, a major multi-institution national investment in human-robot collaboration research.
picks.title: UT To Lead NSF Center That Will Study How Robots and People Learn To Live and Work Together - UT News
picks.university: The University of Texas at Austin

picks.editorial_note: University of Washington researchers are central to three DOE Genesis Mission awards, part of a 300+ institution national push to accelerate scientific discovery with AI — a signature federal AI-for-science initiative.
picks.title: UW researchers lead and support 3 new ‘AI-for-Science’ Genesis Mission awards | UW News

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $90 million commitment to launch three new Science and Technology Centers signals sustained federal policy prioritization of AI alongside biotech, fusion, and robotics research.
picks.title: NSF launches three new Science and Technology Centers with $90M investment in transformative research

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London and Thomson Reuters built a $40 million frontier AI model by fine-tuning an open-source base, demonstrating a lower-cost path for organizations and nations to develop sovereign AI capability.
picks.title: Imperial and Thomson Reuters pioneer new technical approach that could broaden access to sovereign AI

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins' Suchi Saria was named to TIME's 100 most influential people in AI for an FDA-cleared sepsis early-warning system shown to cut mortality by 18%, a rare example of AI delivering measurable clinical impact at scale.
picks.title: Hopkins engineer Suchi Saria among TIME's 100 most influential people in AI

picks.editorial_note: A Brown University mathematician is using AI to attack the Navier-Stokes singularity problem, a nearly 200-year-old open question and Millennium Prize problem, illustrating AI's growing role in fundamental mathematics.
picks.title: From the Lab: How Javier Gómez-Serrano is using AI to solve the most elusive question in math

picks.editorial_note: University of Rochester joins a $30 million NSF center to combine experiments, simulation, and AI to predict and potentially control turbulence, a long-standing hard problem in physics and engineering.
picks.title: Can scientists predict—and control—turbulence?
